title.narrative: [Phase 2 2025 and CGF contrib 2026] Integ Respons to hum. needs of migrants in Central America

description.narrative: This project is a regional effort co-funded between the Swedish Church (ACT A) and CAFOD, it aims to address urgent humanitarian basic and protection needs of displaced people in Central America. The project will reduce the vulnerability of people in transit, return or displacement in El Salvador and Guatemala, Panama, Costa Rica, promoting their protection, assistance and dignity through comprehensive accompaniment (humanitarian, psychosocial and legal) in the framework of International Humanitarian Law (IHL), through a regional strategy between works of the RJM-CA and in alliances with other organisations and institutions of civil society and the Church. On 20 January 2025, after the inauguration, the US President signed executive orders related to migration and borders, suspending humanitarian parole programmes that benefited more than half a million people in transit (Confidential, 2025). Also, mass deportations from the US (WOLA, 2025); at least 61,465 expulsions and inadmissibilities have been reported (CBP, 2025). A number of people continue to be at risk and in need for protection services in Central American countries. The conditions in the countries of origin continue to worsen: those who are working with migrants face significant challenges in providing protection and humanitarian response due to the sudden cuts in humanitarian funding. This project works with people in need of protection (migrants, asylum seekers and stateless people), IDPs, forced or voluntary returns as well as those unable to continue their journey for different reasons. Overall outcome: People in human mobility in Central America receive immediate humanitarian assistance, strengthen their capacities for emotional self-management and access regularisation, protection and integration processes, mitigating their conditions of vulnerability. Out1. Immediate basic humanitarian needs addressed Out2. Psychosocial assistance Out3. Legal assistance and guidance
